cues.text: Footage from a camera high in a corner of the dorm lounge. Shinjiro sits alone on the sofa watching a cooking show on the television, a magazine on the low table in front of him, Koromaru lying on the floor nearby.
Shinjiro snatches the magazine off the table, opens it over his face and sits back with his arms crossed, as if asleep. Koromaru gets up as the front door opens.
Fuuka and Aigis walk in from the entrance, and Koromaru goes to meet them.
Fuuka hurries Aigis away across the lounge and out of sight. Shinjiro, alone again with Koromaru, lifts the magazine off his face, drops it on the table and slumps forward.
